newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on higher demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on higher demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose on higher on Tuesday on demand from local and export buyers after the long Moslem Eid al-Fitr holidays, brokers said.
Brokers said buying was active, with the better quality brokens and fannings teas in demand.

Some 760,480 kg of tea was sold at the auction. The average price was 53.81 taka per kg, 0.84 taka up from previous sale. The next auction will be held on February 25 with an expected offer of 1.2 million kg. ($1 = 42.75 taka)
